serviceIdentification.serviceDescription:
Pinecone is a fully managed vector database for AI applications. It stores, indexes, and
searches high-dimensional vector embeddings to power retrieval for semantic search,
recommendation, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) workloads. Customers create
indexes in a cloud region of their choosing and interact with the service through
documented APIs and client SDKs. The service is operated by Pinecone on public cloud
infrastructure, with customer data encrypted at rest (AES-256, with a distinct data
encryption key for every stored object, so no data key is shared between customers) and in
transit (TLS 1.2 minimum).

trustCenter.repositoryDescription: Pinecone Trust Center. Publishes the SOC 2 Type II report, ISO/IEC 27001 certificate, security policy set, subprocessor list, and current security posture.
trustCenter.accessRequestInstructions: Pinecone's trust center is hosted on Vanta at https://trust.pinecone.io. Agency personnel should: (1) open https://trust.pinecone.io; (2) complete the access request form with first name, last name, work email, company name and a reason (existing customer, prospective customer, or other); (3) select "Request access"; (4) once access is granted, return to the same page to view and download the access-controlled material. Someone who has been granted access before can restore it with "Reclaim access". Federal agency personnel who cannot obtain access this way should contact trust@pinecone.io.

secureConfigurationGuidance.repositoryDescription: Pinecone's public product documentation, covering role-based access control, organization roles and single sign-on, API key and service account management, audit logging, and the production readiness checklist.
